title: Note-Taking App
description: An application for creating, organizing, and managing notes.

features.name: Create Notes
features.description: Allows users to create and save text-based notes.

features.name: Organize Notes
features.description: Enables users to categorize or tag notes for better organization.

features.name: Search Notes
features.description: Provides a search functionality to quickly find specific notes.

target_users: Individuals looking for a simple tool to take and manage notes.
data_requirements: Requires storage for saving user-created notes.
